title: Marine Biodiversity Credits: Opportunities and Considerations for Scaling a Nascent Market for Marine Conservation and Restoration Benefit
content:
ABSTRACT

Biodiversity credits are a measured and evidence-based unit of positive biodiversity outcome. Using lessons from developing the Vanga Seagrass Project, marine biodiversity credits need market engagement, education, guidance for marine governance and considered legislation to scale.
author:
Amelia‐Jane L. Allerton, 
Amber L. Baker, 
Robyn Morland
